name: Nautilus Trader
license: LGPL-3.0; verified from the repository's actual GNU Lesser General Public License Version 3 text
methods: Independent TypeScript replay of the published top-of-book imbalance ratio: min(bestBidSize, bestAskSize) / max(bestBidSize, bestAskSize)
Paper-only BBO-cross scenario: buy at contemporaneous ask when bid depth dominates, sell at contemporaneous bid when ask depth dominates
Coinbase level2 snapshot-plus-update book reconstruction with absolute new_quantity updates, zero-size deletion, and sequence-gap invalidation
Feed signed imbalance, spread, BBO depth, and event-rate features into Zax's existing purged chronological classifier/stump evaluation
reuseDecision: Do not reuse, port, or embed Nautilus Trader code. Independently implement the published method with original TypeScript, names, tests, and documentation; this avoids a Rust/Python execution-engine mismatch and LGPL-derived-code distribution analysis. Do not represent paper scenarios as FOK or queue fills.
requirements: Public Coinbase Advanced Trade level2 WebSocket market data; no JWT, account, portfolio, or private user channel is required for the public feed
Honor Coinbase's documented limit of 8 WebSocket connections/s/IP and 8 unauthenticated messages/s/IP; use a single durable subscription, heartbeat, reconnect backoff, and sequence checks
Historical L2 replay requires Zax's own forward capture or a separately licensed depth archive; no free Coinbase historical-L2 download was verified
Per-instrument calibration data, frozen chronological train/test windows, explicit paper risk cap, fee schedule, and adverse-fill buffer
No vendor installation, broker API, order submission, queue-fill claim, provider registration, or user-data transmission
